_comment: Hand-picked Wikimedia Commons files used ONLY when a US source has no captioned official photo. Matched against the source TITLE. The licence and author are re-checked against the Commons API every time before use (PD, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA only; agency photographers rejected). Non-government photographers are not listed (e.g. the 2025 First Lady portrait by Régine Mahaux is deliberately excluded).
